summary: plan a path or route for the mobile robot to a target map pose, navigation goal, waypoint, x y yaw
description: Computes a navigation path to a target pose without necessarily executing it. Command format: 'path_plan <x> <y> <yaw_deg>' where x and y are map coordinates in metres and yaw_deg is the desired final heading in degrees. Output reports whether a path was found, estimated length, waypoint count, and major warnings. Report success, path length, and failure reasons.
